1→// middleware.ts
     2→import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
     3→import {
     4→    MOCK_ENABLED,
     5→    GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT,
     6→    isUnauthorizedPostRequest,
     7→    handleMockTokens,
     8→    validateTokens,
     9→    extractTokens,
    10→    checkPermission
    11→} from '@/shared/services/middleware'
    12→
    13→export async function middleware(req: NextRequest) {
    14→    // 1) Mock 서버 모드면 mock 토큰 설정 후 통과
    15→    if (MOCK_ENABLED) {
    16→        return handleMockTokens(req)
    17→    }
    18→
    19→    // 2) unauthorized 페이지로의 POST 요청 차단
    20→    if (isUnauthorizedPostRequest(req.nextUrl.pathname, req.method)) {
    21→        return new NextResponse('Method Not Allowed', { status: 405 })
    22→    }
    23→
    24→    // 3) 토큰 검증 (access_token, refresh_token)
    25→    const tokenValidationResult = validateTokens(req)
    26→    if (tokenValidationResult) {
    27→        return tokenValidationResult
    28→    }
    29→
    30→    // 4) 권한 체크 (도메인·경로 기반)
    31→    try {
    32→        const { access_token } = extractTokens(req)
    33→        return await checkPermission(req, access_token, GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT)
    34→    } catch (error) {
    35→        // 토큰 추출 실패 시 로그인 페이지로 리다이렉트
    36→        console.error('Token extraction failed:', error)
    37→        return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', req.url))
    38→    }
    39→}
    40→
    41→export const config = {
    42→    matcher: [
    43→        /*
    44→         * Match all request paths except for the ones starting with:
    45→         * - api (API routes)
    46→         * - _next/static (static files)
    47→         * - _next/image (image optimization files)
    48→         * - favicon.ico (favicon file)
    49→         * - .well-known (browser auto-requests)
    50→         * - AUTH (GraphQL proxy endpoint)
    51→         */
    52→        '/((?!api|billing-api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|\\.well-known|login|unauthorized|error|auth|popup|AUTH|SHOPPING|AI_ATTRIBUTE).*)'
    53→    ]
    54→}
